compiled_state.title: [jira-capability-probe]: STEP_PROPERTY_READ expects unwrapped value -> live probe FAIL when get_issue_property returns {'value': X} dict
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* code_version: 003470ee81af5ef0c3a80a96d833b7b2d962843a (main HEAD)
* surfaced_by: live execution of jira-capability-probe.py against DIG Jira during cfd6 verifier audit
* parent_story: cfd6-8f14-c6b0-4d5f (Jira capability probe)
* related_bug: 75d4-63d0-d39e-4942 (verifier-bypass; surfaces this defect via re-audit)

### 2. Incident Overview
* Scenario Type: User-Flagged Behavior (re-verified during epic 3a03 migration completion)

#### Expected Behavior
STEP_PROPERTY_READ compares `client.get_issue_property(issue_key, "dso_local_id")` against the UUID written in STEP_PROPERTY_WRITE. The probe's value-mismatch check at the comparison site expects the unwrapped property value (string UUID).

#### Actual Behavior
Live probe output:
```
PROBE_FAIL step=STEP_PROPERTY_READ reason=value_mismatch expected=656c1156-0456-48b5-ac33-54cbd861e863 got={'value': '656c1156-0456-48b5-ac33-54cbd861e863'}
```
AcliClient.get_issue_property returns the full Jira response dict ({'value': ...}) instead of unwrapping `response['value']`. Either:
(a) jira-capability-probe.py should compare against `got.get('value')`, OR
(b) acli-integration.py AcliClient.get_issue_property should return `response['value']` (the property value, matching the spec).

The acli-integration.py docstring for get_issue_property says "returns the 'value' field from the response per the Jira issue properties API contract" — so the AcliClient method IS supposed to unwrap. The bug is in AcliClient.get_issue_property; the probe is correct.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* Related rule: rule:dispatch-verifier — this bug was surfaced by re-running verifier on previously-closed-without-evidence story per bug 75d4-63d0-d39e-4942.
* Discovery context: epic 3a03-b3f2-b34c-4e4f migration-completion audit.
